reason.rotation: Enter the 15s Armed for Action state with Skill. Use infused attacks to build Sword Essence and spend it on Windborne Sword. Burst costs 60 Energy and supplies Essence. Leaving early removes Disciplinary Action stacks.
reason.open: Verify the order and number of Essence builders and spenders under the draft team’s Cryo aura and healing windows. Check Finale’s Bond of Life clearance and whether burst cadence is feasible. No verified number of rotations or damage ranking is assumed.
reason.gear: ATK/Anemo/CRIT with Skill-first fits her on-field kit. Scarlet Proof is tied to Stellar Swirl ownership; A Day Carved From Rising Winds needs its specified attack sequence. Favonius is an ER tradeoff, with a separate damage cost.

reason.rotation: Use Skill before switching to the desired recipient. The Skill lasts 16s, heals active characters every 1.5s, and has a 16s cooldown. Treat the 60-Energy Burst as a separate damage or Prototype Amber trigger, not a precondition for Skill healing.
reason.open: Verify off-field Skill hit timing for Tenacity, the actual 20s Thrilling Tales cooldown alignment, the intended recipient, and whether to skip Burst outside Prototype Amber rotations. The draft’s Shenhe slot supports Odette’s Cryo output; it is not assumed to buff Vesna’s Anemo damage.
reason.gear: HP/HP/Healing Bonus and Skill-first match Max HP healing. Song of Days Past needs actual healing and Tenacity needs landed Skill hits. Pinned Heritage R5 gives +48% ATK to the next character for 10s every 20s; +24% is R1. No community usage inputs.
